name: Abyssal 1
description: Plongeur des abysses récupérant les artefacts engloutis des stations submergées lors des grandes inondations.

subject.archetype: Abyssal 1 — Exode pélagique Common class eau

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic coral armor grown from living reef material with bioluminescent combat indicators pulsing in rapid rhythm, hydrodynamic fins extending from arms and calves streaming in current, translucent membranes trailing from shoulders
loadout.arsenal: Bioluminescent harpoon cannon with living coral barrel pulsing with each discharge, hydro-kinetic gauntlets channeling water into pressurized cutting jets visible as focused force streams The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting self_on_flip, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Body flipping violently between states as captured with both hands slamming into ground sending focused targeted shockwave through all adjacent positions, final devastating act of dying warrior
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Abyssal Deep Blue
palette_names.role: primary_accent — skin tones and surrounding water mass

palette_names.name: Bioluminescent Cyan
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — ability effects and natural body glow

palette_names.name: Foam White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — spray splashes and bubble highlights

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Storm-ravaged aquatic colonial battlefield with massive waves crashing over organic structures sending debris flying, lightning illuminating in stark flashes, allied forces pushed back while bioluminescent defensive flares light the water column with cyan bursts
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Explosive shockwave radiating outward in perfect circle with incredible force, visible ring of energy passing through all adjacent positions simultaneously with cascading chain reaction, Ground erupting with visible shockwave, debris lifted and thrown outward by force, visible damage spreading to all adjacent tiles as energy wave passes through, Massive waves crashing and spraying bioluminescent droplets everywhere, water vortex spiraling around character pulling debris, glowing fish scattering in panic, bubbles erupting from seabed, electrical arcs flashing through charged seawater
